item.title: Capitalism Fails? Wall Street Journal Columnist Rails Against Billionaires Evading Taxes
item.description: Capitalism Fails? Wall Street Journal Columnist Rails Against Billionaires Evading Taxes The Wall Street Journal has promoted itself as the "Daily Diary of the American Dream," as a promoter of national prosperity. But some columnists find the titans of capitalism too unseemly to support any more.
